name: Bridger's Crossing
site_type: ford | Inhabited locations | Ranchstead and customary river crossing.
history: The crossing has been used by Varkesh and Rathen herders for generations. Following the War of Broken Banners, Amos Bridger established a modest ranchstead nearby, maintaining an informal agreement permitting passing herders continued access to the water.
current_state: Four-Spur has acquired a grazing concession encompassing the crossing and intends to fence the surrounding pastures. Surveyors have recently placed boundary markers near the ranchstead.
inhabitants: Amos Bridger (N-001), his family, ranch hands, and occasional traveling herders. Four-Spur surveyors and armed riders periodically visit.
danger_level: Low ordinarily; potentially moderate if the dispute escalates.
points_of_interest:
Ranchstead; old livestock ford; weathered Varkesh trail markers; sheltered riverside campsite; Four-Spur boundary stakes.

Unresolved elements: The precise boundaries of the concession and customary agreement.; Whether Amos can meet his obligations to Four-Spur without surrendering access to the crossing.; How the company and herders respond to the impending enclosure.
discovery: Along a tributary of the Redwash. Local ranchers and Varkesh herders know the crossing. Amos may request assistance through the Redwash Exchange.

source_reference: Accepted campaign record example developed after Handbook v0.4; updated category metadata and potential related leads.
